Task: Managed Model Platform Workflow

Write Python code that invokes a provider-managed model through a project-, deployment-, or inference-profile-scoped platform client using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential
from azure.ai.ml import MLClient
from azure.ai.ml.entities import Model, ModelFramework, ModelType
from azure.ai.ml import Input, Output

credential = DefaultAzureCredential()
subscription_id = "<SUBSCRIPTION_ID>"
resource_group = "<RESOURCE_GROUP>"
workspace_name = "<WORKSPACE_NAME>"

ml_client = MLClient(credential, subscription_id, resource_group, workspace_name)

# Link the model to the workspace if not already registered
model_name = "example-model"
model_version = "1"
model_framework = ModelFramework.ONNX
model_type = ModelType.ONNX

existing_model = ml_client.models.get(model_name, version=model_version)
if existing_model is None:
    model_path = "./model.onnx"
    ml_client.models.create_or_update(
        Model(
            name=model_name,
            version=model_version,
            path=model_path,
            framework=model_framework,
            framework_version="1.8",
            description="Example ONNX model",
        )
    )

# Create an online deployment for the model
deployment_name = "example-deployment"
compute_name = "cpu-cluster"  # Ensure this compute cluster exists in your workspace

ml_client.online_deployments.create_or_update(
    model_name=model_name,
    model_version=model_version,
    deployment_name=deployment_name,
    compute=compute_name,
    app_insights_enabled=True,
    code_configuration=".",
    environment="AzureML-Miniconda",
    model_framework=model_framework,
    model_framework_version=model_framework.version,
    model_type=model_type,
    cpu_cores=1,
    memory_in_gb=1,
)

# Invoke the deployed model
response = ml_client.online_endpoints.invoke(
    endpoint_name="example-endpoint",
    deployment_name=deployment_name,
    request_file="sample-request.json"
)

# Print the inference response
print(response)
